packageRules.description: A173-F2: Production dependencies require human review (supply-chain risk)
Auto-merge patch & minor updates for devDependencies only
Require manual review for major updates — kept as individual PRs via :separateMultipleMajorReleases
Group GitHub Actions patch & minor updates — matchUpdateTypes excludes majors so a single major bump cannot poison the group's automerge resolution
Group devDependency patch & minor updates — matchUpdateTypes excludes majors for the same reason; majors are handled individually by the rule above
